overall_meaning: The preregistered v1 questions were answered and the track is closed. This is NOT a blanket renderer PASS: two of its answers are negative and stay negative.

geometry_intersection.boundary: G1 zero silhouette disagreement against an independent CPU Moller-Trumbore intersector over 24 views for both mesh specimens, worst range difference 1.4e-6 m; G2 analytic sphere within 0.03 px and 2.4e-8 m. The experiment's own verdict remains GEOMETRY_DEFECT because the G3/G4/G7 measurement tolerances were not met; that verdict is not revised.

measurement_resolution.boundary: 1280x960 on three specimens, 24 views, 2 m, 60 degree FOV, against a sampled 2048x1536 reference. A measured finite-resolution discrepancy, not a proof of absolute accuracy, and not valid for distant or subpixel objects or other cameras.

area_control.boundary: Held-out median 8.132 % and P90 11.051 % against registered 5 % and 10 % gates: AREA_CONTROL_FAILED. The historical isotropic control also failed (RC-R2 AREA_MATCH_FAILED). No area-matched control exists in this repository.

normal_representation.boundary: Face normals only. N1 interpolated and N2 smooth arms are UNSUPPORTED because the asset and loader contract carry no authored vertex normals or smoothing groups; they are not null results.

lighting_material_isolation.boundary: 36 lighting cells and 5 material sets on the recorded fixed grids left all six geometry buffers byte-identical while luminance moved. Measured for this shader on these grids, not guaranteed for arbitrary future shaders.

determinism.boundary: Identical arrays across two independent OS processes at one recorded source, config and environment. Not a claim about other hardware, drivers or library versions.

transfer_cost.boundary: Four transfer strategies with seven identical output hashes; the host strategy is 88 % of the large-fixture staged total for the individual-copy arm. Cost description only: no production path was switched, and this is not a PCIe bandwidth claim.

dataset_exporter.boundary: Buffer meanings, miss sentinels, camera conventions and export status are machine-readable and test-checked against decoded output. Export status stays EXPORTED_UNASSESSED and training remains NOT_SUPPORTED.

closure_rule: No R2c/R3c-style continuation of a failed renderer gate. A Renderer Contract v2 is opened only when a separate question justifies it, under its own preregistration.
d8b_boundary: D8b frozen-policy sensitivity remains MATERIAL_LOSS at -48.967 pp. No renderer result in this track establishes area mismatch, shading or mesh geometry as its cause.
